lines.en: I knock on Otoha’s door and wait for her to answer.
I’ve gotten to spend time with her at[school] and in the park before, but...
The two of us haven't really gotten to be alone in her dorm without any interference from others yet.
Not that I expect anything exciting to happen, but she’s proven to be excitingly...normal by now.
And, given that I spend my life surrounded by people like Molly and Tsuneyo and Ayane and...
Well, you get the point.
There are a lot of strange girls in my class.
So I shall wait patiently for this one particular outlier to answer.
I can no longer be patient.
: Otoha, are you in there?
: Mmph! Unn...sec!
: ...What?
: Mngh. Sorry! I was eating.
: Door’s open.
I walk into the room and kick my shoes off at the door, hoping that I’ll wind up staying here for at least an hour or two so I don’t have to awkwardly put them back on after like five minutes.
That has happened before and it has not been enjoyable.
: Heeeeeey...
: Isn’t it a little late for you to be coming over?
: I’m already in relax-mode.
: You look very comfortable.
: And hungry.
: Hahah...yeah...
: Nodoka’s at some bookstore with Futaba tonight and Rin’s playing some game with her other friends, so I figured I’d just...do my own thing.
: And your own thing is gorging yourself on doughnuts and-
: Wait, is that the sausage fest?
: I was curious, okay?! You made it sound so...sausagey!
: Otoha’s first sausage fest...and I get to be here for it.
: Niki would be so proud...
: Do you want something or are you just here to try and embarrass me?
: Just thought I’d come see what you were up to.
: You look nice with your hair down, by the way.
: Yeah? Thank you.
: I really only put it up because I friggin' hate how it feels when the wind pushes it into my eyes.
: Surprised it’s not like, too red for you or whatever.
: I mean, Ami’s hair is completely red and I haven’t gotten fed up with that yet.
: Yeah but Ami’s hair is cute and mine is just...hair.
: Yes. Your hair is hair.
: Yeah, see? You get it.
I don’t.
: Do you want a doughnut?
: I’ll probably eat all of them if you don’t take any and I don’t think my body will like that very much.
: No. But your heart will.
: What does that even mean?
: It means that you should do whatever makes you happy. And if that means eating a box of doughnuts and two pounds of sausage noodles, so be it.
: Welp, I did pay for all of it...so I might as well go to town.
: Oh hey, are you good with technology by any chance? Because I can’t get this stupid TV to listen to me.
: What’s going on?
: It’s just not doing anything when I press any of the buttons.
: Maybe the remote is dead?
: The buttons on the TV aren’t working either. It’s just stuck on some weird picture.
: I think it might be frozen.
: Have you tried turning it off and back on?
: Just tell me you’re not good with this kind of stuff if you’re going to keep giving me generic tips.
: Hey, you would be surprised how many things can be fixed by turning them off and then back on.
: I have tried that, Sensei. It’s just-
: You know what? Never mind. I’ll just keep myself entertained by talking to the old guy in my room like everyone else does here.
I somehow manage to defeat a magical rectangle in the battle for a [young_girl]’s attention.
I ascend.
: Couldn’t you have just played with Rin and the other girls? I’m pretty sure they’re right next door since Molly is like, the leader of their...game group or whatever.
: I would have, but Rin seemed weirdly against me coming for some reason.
: I’m not that close with any of the others yet anyway. She probably just wanted to avoid things being awkward.
Or she wanted to avoid you thinking she’s a nerd...which sounds a lot closer to what Rin would do if she’s approaching Otoha the same way she approached Chika.
: The game they play is kind of weird anyway. We’re better off in here.
: Is it like, a video game or something?
: Not really. They all have these weird sheets of paper and talk in strange voices to one another.
: Huh.
: Well that definitely doesn’t sound like any game I’ve ever played before.
: Like I said, we’re better off in here where-
: SEVEN VIOLET FUNGUS APPEAR! ROLL FOR INITIATIVE!
: Molly! Shh!
: Like I was saying, we’re better off in here where it’s safe.
: I guess you’re right.
: Besides, I've barely eaten all day...so I should probably do that now anyway.
: Well you...certainly have the required materials to do just that.
: I’m a growing girl, okay?! And if I don’t eat balanced meals, I’ll wind up looking all tired and dead inside like that one teacher Nodoka has the hots for!
: The one that isn't you! The girl one! With the skirt!
: What exactly is balanced about your dinner, Otoha?
: It’s got all the food groups! Sausage, pastry, soda! Come on, man!
: You have no idea what to do now that you have to provide food for yourself, do you?
: Well I obviously don’t think those are the real food groups, but...yeah.
: I’m used to my parents making dinner for me...so I’m stretching my wings and eating stuff that makes me happy instead of...green stuff.
: You poor, lost soul.
: I’m sure I used to be just like you until I acquired a [niece].
: Oh, yeah. Let me just go out and get one of those really quick. Great advice.
: Ahh!
: It’s just your phone, Otoha.
: You don’t actually get scared that easily, do you?
: Of course not! I just...wasn’t ready for that.
: It surprised me.
: So what you’re telling me is you...got scared.
: Shut up. I’ve gotta take this.
: Hold your ears closed and...don’t listen to what I say in case it’s some...super secret business or something.
: Right...
Otoha grabs her phone and hops off of the bed, nearly killing the sausage fest in the process.
Instead of exiting the room, which is what I expected her to do on account of telling me not to listen, she takes a seat on her stool and answers the call.
: Hello?...
: Yeah.
: Yeah. I’m eating fine.
: You fucking liar.
: Shh!
Otoha shushes me and whatever object has taken the place of my heart skips a beat.
: Huh?!
: What?!
: No! You didn’t hear a boy just now! That was the TV!
: No, it really was! Listen!
: Help me...
I decide to help Otoha by mimicking my favorite television program.
: Take that, you little slut.
: Sorry! My roommate just changed the channel on accident! I’m leaving the room now!
My favorite television program is highly pornographic, by the way.
: No! I’m doing totally fine! I don’t need any money!
: Yeah. Yeah,[school] is great.
: My teacher?
: Well, uhh...
: He could be better.
: What the fuck?
: Yeah...
: Yeah.
: Okay.
: Love you too. Bye.
: How was your phone call?
: I invite you...into my home...and offer you one of my doughnuts...
: And this is how you repay me?
: By mimicking a porno?
: It has normal scenes as well. I just chose one of the racy ones.
: That was porn! I know porn when I hear it!
: Do you?
: Yes but don’t misinterpret that!
: There’s really only one way to interpret that, Otoha.
: Sensei! That was my mom! You can’t just yell things like-
: Oi! Quiet down in there! There are other people on this server, you know?!
: Ah! Sorry! Sorry!
Otoha throws her phone onto the bed, once again almost killing the sausage fest, before moving past me and sitting back down.
Just...this time, she looks a lot less pleased with me than she did when I first arrived.
: If this is what having an older brother is like, I’m glad I was born an only child.
: Oh come on. I’m sure that one day we’ll look back on this and laugh about it.
: Yeah. Totally. I can hear it now.
: “Hey, remember when you called me a little slut while I was on the phone with my mom?”
: “Hahaha. So funny.”
: In my defense, I was not calling you a little slut. It was a line from the-
: Sensei...
: Am I...in trouble?
: Yes.
: Seriously. Don’t do stuff like that.
: It’s nothing short of a miracle that I was even allowed to come live here.
: One wrong move and that could all come to an end. My parents know the address of this place and they could come get me at any moment.
: Oh great. I’m sure that’s not an omen for them to show up at the worst possible time in the future.
: There won’t be a future if you keep doing stuff like that.
: I’ve obviously come around to hanging out in here with you if we're both bored, but please don’t do things that will make my leash even tighter.
: Just take the leash off entirely and stop answering them.
: Dude, no. They’re still my parents.
: Just be respectful and stay away from sex jokes while I’m talking to them. That’s all I want.
: And maybe 1,000 yen. That would be cool too.
: You and this damn 1,000 yen. I literally just heard you tell your mom you didn’t need any money.
: Doesn’t mean I don’t want any. Pay up, Sensei. It’s a fine for being a jerk.
: I’ll give you 1,000 yen...but I need the doughnuts in return.
: Wait, all of them?!
: I thought you didn’t want any!
: It’s for your own good, Otoha.
: Besides, once you try the sausage fest, you’ll never want to eat anything else ever again.
: I already had a few bites.
: It’s...extremely average.
: How dare you...
: Ugh. Keep your money. I’ll just eat my doughnuts and watch this weird picture of a house until-
: Oh. The TV went back to normal.
: When did that happen?
: Beats me. I’m glad things worked out, though.
: I was starting to think I may have ruined your night.
: You did ruin my night, but I signed up for that when I invited you in.
: I like this. This is good.
: Like what? What’s good?
: Us. You don’t let me walk all over you but you aren’t extremely abrasive in telling me to stop.
: Yeah, I just think you’re really annoying.
: Now shush. I’m gonna watch TV and eat junk food all night and you can either hang out and deal with that or just get out.
: Understood. Move over.
I take a seat next to Otoha and do ultimately receive a doughnut.

She manages to finish the other three as well as the entire sausage fest, and I suddenly feel the urge to visit Maya and inform her that there may be someone else in the class who is just as good at eating as her.
I don’t, though.
Instead, I hang out and watch some reality show with Otoha until Nodoka gets home.
It was a surprisingly refreshing night, all things considered.
Otoha’s affection has increased to [otoha_love]!
